title: How To Actually Achieve Your Goals in 2026
coverage: expanded selected original paragraphs with speaker/header context; not full source

passages.text: Most people are addicted to the **feeling of being busy**, but they’re actually standing still. Not making meaningful progress.
Today, I’m giving you my **CLARITY** **Prompt Chain**. I used this exact prompt chain earlier in 2025 to realize I was spending 50% of my time on tasks that generated near 0% of my growth.
For this to work best, AI needs to know who you are. If you haven’t yet, follow this tutorial tobuild your **AI Second Brain.**
This prompt forces AI to reflect your reality back to you, so you can see your time-leaks in black and white.
Feel free to drop in monthly calendar screenshots to give AI even more context about where your time goes!
By forcing AI to ask *you* clarifying questions and share its real-time Confidence Score, you ensure answers are based on your actual data, not hypotheticals.
Ask me clarifying questions, one at a time, until you're 95% confident in your answer. Always state your confidence score.

The next hard part is having the courage to ignore the other 999+ things on your list. Even though you know they’re lower-leverage, maybe you enjoy doing them or you’re competent in them, so it feels good doing them.
It’s really really hard, even for me, to stay focused. I’m far from perfect. But even small improvements, over a long time horizon, compound into big gains.
So, I recommend running this Clarity Prompt Chain once a quarter to ensure you haven’t drifted back into the “busy work” trap.
